V1.12c

notes.title: Bleeding_Edge update with further stability fixes and performance improvements
notes.notes:
There's an update in bleeding_edge, if anyone fancies trying it. I think I finally found all of the potential issues with joints attaching to null. I've had *ridiculous*-sized motherships now and absolutely no physics tornados. Prove me wrong! ;)

V1.11
	-Joint disconnection is now smarter and 2-way, avoiding a potential 1-tick issue with joint forces.
	-Fixed issue with dangling Twin Distance Joints.
	-CPU Optimisation to rotating objects
	-Low Detail now uses lower-quality normal maps.
	-Fixed an issue causing a huge GPU performance overhead with non-instancing sprite rendering.
	-Added some missing pad vibrations
	-Fixed issue with a single distance joint filling up all the slots
	-Removed unneeded physics joints for CPU performance

I haven't got time to test it properly before travelling for Christmas, so it'll sit there for a bit - feedback welcome!

notes.title: Patch V1.09 live!
notes.notes:
This patch focuses on 2 areas. Firstly, I've fixed an issue with the previous leaderboard system, where people's Endless/Rogue scores were uploaded to the story mode, along implementing a workout for a known bug in the Steam Leaderboards. This is a retroactive fix, so the next time you enter any game mode, your record for that mode will be uploaded, so it should take 30 seconds or so to get back onto your well-deserved spot on the Leaderboard.

The other change was around me committing the cardinal sin of 'believing what the comments tell you' - I was MEANT to add in "up to 2 engines per evolutions", but instead, I was adding 'up to 2 engines' Whoops. The net upshot is that Motherships are now *far* better at chasing you down. I've given this some playtesting, but if you feel the game is suddenly way, way too hard, please let me know!

That list in full!

[list]
[*]Reworked Leaderboard upload code to side-step a very old bug around leaderboards that Valve never fixed
[*]Motherships will now evolve the correct number of engines, and are a lot less prone to turtling. Sorry. You lived through the golden era.
[*]Fixed pause sometimes not pausing
[*]Changed threshold for 'only' achievements from 100% to 98%, so the Mothership can bonk into an occasional rock without making the achievement impossible
[*] I've had to delete a number of incorrect Leaderboard entries. They will be re-uploaded appropriately, so you don't need to break your existing record to get yourself back on the leaderboard at the right place.
[*] Further improvements to tornado physics.
[/list]

notes.title: Another patch?!
notes.notes: After a little bit of trash talking, I decided that the best way to settle who`s best is to hook up to Steam`s leaderboards. This should now be live, and will show your highest Evolution in Rogue and Endless modes, and the highest difficulty unlocked. I`ll do the obvious code and display the highest leaderboard entry soon, but I wanted to get the leaderboards populating with more than just a couple of people first!

notes.title: V1.02 Patch now live!
notes.notes:
I've done my best to break the habit of a lifetime, and venture into social media sites and instead of lurking, shout at about what I've done. I hate it, I still feel [i]If you build it, they will come[/i], but in reality, you need to get up on your soapbox and shout as loudly as possible about what you've created!

This patch represents fixes and changes based on the most common pieces of feedback from Reddit, Imgur, Discord, etc.

Speaking of the Discord : https://discord.gg/wNGyEJHQnG

[list]
[*]Added difficulty, records and time info to the Status Report (Back on an Xbox pad)
[*]Mouse cursor is now confined and invisible
[*]Implemented a Radial Arrow to help people understand the Radial Menu better
[*]Made the MotherShip directional indicator less subtle when you're more than 7 units away
[*]Fixed issue where exploding title screen mothership could hide away new game messages
[*]Moved a bunch of UI elements align to the centre of the screen. Shocking.
[*]Radial Bars now correctly empty as the NanoSystems bring them back online
[*]Fixed stuck 'Warp Detected' mission guide message
[*]Mothership can now decide to face weapons in the opposite direction.
[*]Fixed warping effect scale
[*]Added sound effects for asteroid impacts
[*]Added sounds effects for Player impacts
[*]Fixed bug where Electric Arc could ONLY hurt on the title screen, instead of anywhere[*]but.
[*]Fixed issue where people could outrun the Graviton forever
[/list]

notes.title: First patch of 2023!
notes.notes: A tiny fix to the Mothership Missiles; they were firing without a tracking solution, so they just ended up turning into very odd mines. The aliens in charge of the firing solutions have now been sacked, and last minute crew from Norway have been hired at great expense.
